title: Skill Ladder Lesson
subtitle: Five moves from very easy to very hard, each broken down with the 3D body reconstructed from the video.
sourceNote: one public skills compilation (credit its creators before any real use), the body motion reconstructed from it, and measurements taken from that motion.

skills.name: Hocus pocus at speed
skills.intro: The “very easy” level is the roll-back hocus pocus: stop the ball, roll it back, tap it in, flick it behind your standing leg and go. It’s the same night clip that opens the Hocus Pocus lesson, which breaks it down step by step.

notice.title: Stop it
notice.text: Under his foot as the defender steps in.

notice.title: Roll and tap
notice.text: Back under his body, then across.

notice.title: Behind the leg
notice.text: The ball foot whips behind the standing leg.

notice.title: Exit
notice.text: Past the defender before they turn.

unsure: Detail at night: low light and a moving camera make this clip’s 3D rough.
Which leg is which when they cross: the lesson names feet by job.

phases.name: Stop it
phases.cue: Stop the ball as the defender steps in.
phases.video: He arrives at the ball and stops it under his foot.
phases.shows: He comes in low, up to about 14 cm below standing height, as the defender closes.
phases.why: Night, moving camera.

phases.name: Roll and tap
phases.cue: Roll it back; tap it across.
phases.video: The sole rolls it back, then a tap moves it across.
phases.shows: 2 touches in about 0.7 s.
phases.why: Night, moving camera; touches are counted within a few centimetres.

phases.name: Behind the leg
phases.cue: Flick it behind your standing leg.
phases.video: The ball foot goes behind the standing leg and sends the ball the other way.
phases.shows: A ball-foot touch at about 1.90 s as the ball foot goes behind.
phases.why: The legs cross; one camera can’t say which is in front.

phases.name: Exit
phases.cue: Accelerate past.
phases.video: He’s past the defender’s lunge.
phases.shows: He drops about 30 cm into the sprint.
phases.why: Fast and blurred.

challenges.title: Spot the flick
challenges.prompt: Tap when the ball foot whips behind the standing leg.
challenges.label: Now!
challenges.explain: The flick is the last touch before the exit.

challenges.title: Why roll it back first?
challenges.prompt: Frozen during the roll back. What does rolling it back do?
options: Brings the ball under his body, away from the defender’s foot
challenges.explain: Pulling it under him takes it out of the defender’s reach and sets up the flick.

skills.name: Shift and push past
skills.intro: Dribble at the defender, shift the ball across your body to make them lunge, then push it back the other way past them and chase it.

notice.title: Dribble in
notice.text: Ball between his feet, defender ahead.

notice.title: Shift it
notice.text: A touch moves the ball across his body.

notice.title: Push past
notice.text: As the defender lunges, he pushes it back the other way.

notice.title: Chase
notice.text: He runs onto it behind the defender.

unsure: The move’s name: the video only labels its difficulty.
Detail at night: low light and a moving camera make this clip’s 3D rough.
Which part of the foot shifts the ball: it’s hidden behind his body.

phases.why: Fast; the defender partly blocks the view.

phases.why: Fast and blurred.

challenges.title: Why shift it first?
challenges.prompt: Frozen after the shift. What is the shift for?
options: To make the defender lunge one way
challenges.explain: Once they commit to the lunge, the push the other way is easy.

challenges.title: Spot the push

challenges.label: Push!
challenges.explain: The push comes as the defender lunges.

skills.name: Rainbow flick
skills.intro: The rainbow flick: trap the ball between your feet, roll it up the back of your leg with the other heel and flick it over your head and the defender.

notice.title: Run at him
notice.text: Ball between his feet, defender waiting.

notice.title: Set it
notice.text: He stops with the ball between his feet.

notice.title: Flick
notice.text: The back heel rolls it up and over.

notice.title: Over the top
notice.text: The ball goes over him and the defender.

unsure: How high the ball goes: its height is estimated from its size on screen.
The replay after 8.33 s is blurred, so its 3D is unreliable.

phases.name: Run at him
phases.cue: Ball close; get near the defender.
phases.video: He dribbles towards the defender in daylight.
phases.shows: 4 close touches as he approaches.
phases.why: Clear daylight view from behind.

phases.name: Set it
phases.cue: Ball between your feet, in front of the back heel.
phases.video: He stops with the ball trapped between his feet.
phases.shows: His body drops about 20 cm as he sets the ball.
phases.why: The ball is partly hidden by his legs.

phases.name: Flick
phases.cue: Roll it up the back of your leg; flick it over.
phases.video: The heel rolls the ball up the back of his leg and flicks it over his head.
phases.shows: A touch at 7.53 s, then the ball is marked in the air.
phases.why: The flick touch is clear; ball height is approximate.

phases.name: Over the top
phases.cue: Run on and collect it.
phases.video: The ball drops in front of him beyond the defender.
phases.shows: The body rises as he runs on after the ball.
phases.why: The ball’s flight path is the least reliable reading.

phases.name: Slow replay
phases.cue: A blurred slow-motion replay.
phases.video: A different angle, blurred: nothing to copy here.
phases.shows: Blurred footage: the 3D here isn’t reliable.
phases.why: Motion blur.

challenges.title: Where is the ball?
challenges.prompt: Frozen as he sets it. Where is the ball?
options: Trapped between his feet, against the back heel
challenges.explain: The rainbow starts with the ball held between the feet so the heel can roll it up.

challenges.title: Spot the flick
challenges.prompt: Tap when the ball leaves his heel.
challenges.label: Flick!
challenges.explain: The heel touch sends it up the back of his leg.

skills.name: Quick touches and cut
skills.intro: A run of quick, small touches and feints right in front of the defender, then a sharp cut past them.

notice.title: Run at him
notice.text: Ball ahead, defender waiting.

notice.title: Quick feet
notice.text: Small touches and feints around the ball.

notice.title: Shift

notice.title: Cut past
notice.text: Past the defender’s side and away.

unsure: The move’s name: the video only labels its difficulty.
Detail at night: low light and a moving camera make this clip’s 3D rough.
Exactly which touches are feints and which move the ball: the feet are very close to it throughout.

skills.name: Ball one side, run the other
skills.intro: A big feint step, then he plays the ball past the defender on one side and runs round the other to collect it.

notice.title: Angle in

notice.title: Big feint

notice.title: Ball past
notice.text: The ball goes past the defender on its own.

notice.title: Collect
notice.text: He meets it on the other side.

unsure: The move’s name: the video only labels its difficulty.
Whether the ball goes through the defender’s legs (a nutmeg): it isn’t clear from this angle.

limits: Three of the five clips are filmed at night with a moving phone: their 3D is rough and marked so.
The difficulty labels are the video’s own; move names are descriptive, apart from the rainbow flick.
tests: Whether a ladder of levels motivates learners more than separate lessons, and whether the levels feel right.
